name: spreadsheetAddChart
syntax: spreadsheetAddChart(spreadsheetObj, { type, series, from, to, title })
description: Adds a chart to the active sheet of a spreadsheet workbook. The chart struct accepts type (line, line3d, bar, bar3d, pie, pie3d, doughnut or area, default line), series (an array or delimited list of sheet-qualified ranges such as "Sheet1!$A$2:$A$10"), from and to (anchor A1 cells) and an optional title. The fluent member form is addChart({...}).

params.name: spreadsheetObj
params.description: The spreadsheet workbook object to add the chart to.

params.name: chart
params.description: Struct describing the chart: type (line|line3d|bar|bar3d|pie|pie3d|doughnut|area), series (array or list of sheet-qualified ranges), from (top-left anchor cell, default "C1"), to (bottom-right anchor cell, default "H15") and title.

examples.title: Bar chart over a query
examples.description: Write scores to a sheet, then add a bar chart anchored at E1.
